long_biography.plain_text:
Bess built his early career in sales and marketing at NCR and AT&T before joining Trend Micro, where he helped expand its internet-security business globally. He became Palo Alto Networks' chief executive in 2008, secured late-stage financing and scaled its commercial operation toward an eventual public listing. At Zscaler, he served as chief operating officer during another formative growth period.

He founded Bess Ventures and Advisory in 2015, using proceeds from those operating successes to back cybersecurity, infrastructure software and semiconductor companies. Bess later moved from investor and executive chair to chief executive of Deep Instinct, a deep-learning cybersecurity company, while chairing Blaize. Outside business, two Blue Origin flights made him the first parent to reach space with a child and later one of the few repeat New Shepard passengers.
